import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots()

# Create bar chart for LN PME Using S&P 500 TR
ax1.bar(df['Vintage'], df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], color='skyblue', alpha=0.7, label='LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')
ax1.set_xlabel('Vintage Year')
ax1.set_ylabel('LN PME Using S&P 500 TR', color='skyblue')

# Create line chart for Preqin Median Net IRR
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(df['Vintage'], df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], color='red', marker='o', label='Preqin Median Net IRR')
ax2.set_ylabel('Preqin Median Net IRR', color='red')

# Add title and legend
plt.title('Combo Chart of Preqin Median Net IRR and LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')
fig.tight_layout()
fig.legend(loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.1,0.9))

# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Vintage', 'y_fields': ['Preqin Median Net IRR', 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], 'chart_type': 'comboChart'}
plt.show()
